name: LONASE (Loterie Nationale Sénégalaise)
verdict: Senegal's public lottery and games-of-chance operator, a named sponsor of ASC Ville de Dakar's 2026 BAL campaign.

why.text: Amnesty International says Senegalese security forces killed at least 65 protesters and arrested a further 2,000 people between 2021 and 2024. LONASE, one of the club's sponsors, is Senegal's public lottery operator, a public enterprise of the Senegalese state.
why.messageLine: Amnesty International says Senegalese security forces killed at least 65 protesters between 2021 and 2024.

note: Rating note: on hold for a maintainer. Propose 'serious' per METHOD.md — LONASE is a Senegalese public enterprise ('entreprise publique', '100% Public' per its own site; created as a 'Société Nationale' by law in 1987), so the state with the documented 2021–2024 protest-crackdown record (Amnesty, HRW) controls it. Same France/Renault caveat as the Port Autonome de Dakar: the protest-policing character of the record is for a maintainer to weigh.
